responsibility: This header provides the GCC target configuration for MIPS NetBSD systems. It defines NetBSD-specific target and CPU preprocessor builtins, overrides the generic MIPS CPU builtin policy to match NetBSD expectations, installs NetBSD-specific CPP and linker specs, adjusts assembler PIC behavior, small-data defaults, cache-flush naming, and wide-character type conventions, making it the OS-layer integration header for the NetBSD MIPS port.
